reveal.confirm: I stored this value somewhere safe

agents.title: Know who's asking.
agents.description: Agents authenticate with a bootstrap key to request or fulfil secret exchanges.

empty.title: No agents enrolled
empty.body: Enroll an agent to give it a bootstrap key.

agents.boundary: Active means enrolled and not revoked; it doesn't show whether an agent is online. Revoking stops new tokens and requests; it can't recall secrets already delivered.

fields.agentIdHint: Up to 128 letters, digits and . _ : @ / -. It can't be changed later.

create.title: Enroll an agent
create.body: The controller issues a bootstrap key that is shown once.

rotate.label: Rotate the key for {{agent}}
rotate.title: Rotate the key for {{agent}}?
rotate.body: The current key stops working immediately. The agent needs the replacement before it can request tokens again.

revoke.label: Revoke {{agent}}
revoke.title: Revoke {{agent}}?
revoke.body: The agent's key and tokens stop working. Secrets it already received are not recalled. This can't be undone.

reveal.bootstrapBody: Store this key in the agent's runtime now. The controller keeps only a hash and can't show it again.
reveal.replacementBody: The previous key no longer works. Store this replacement before closing; it can't be shown again.
reveal.label: Bootstrap API key

errors.taken: An agent with this ID already exists.
errors.unknown: The controller didn't answer. The agent may have been created without showing its key; check the list, and rotate its key if it appears.
errors.rotateUnknown: The controller didn't answer. The old key may already be invalid; rotate again to get a key you can see.
errors.revokeUnknown: The controller didn't answer. Check the list to see whether the agent was revoked.
errors.gone: This agent is no longer active. The list has been refreshed.

policy.title: Set the boundaries.
policy.description: Which agents may exchange which secrets, and which exchanges need an operator's decision.
policy.readOnly: Only administrators can change the exchange policy.
policy.evaluation: Rules are checked top to bottom and the first match decides. A request no rule matches is refused.

hints.list: One agent ID per line. Leave empty to match any agent.
hints.approvers: Operator usernames or IDs, one per line. Required for this decision.

policy.otherFieldsEdit: Kept unchanged: {{fields}}. Edit them in the JSON view.
policy.emptyRulesBody: With no rules, every exchange request is refused.

json.label: Policy document
json.hint: The exact document the controller stores. Fields the form doesn't show are edited here.
json.invalid: This isn't a valid policy document. It needs secret_registry and exchange_policy arrays.

policy.issuesInline: Each problem is shown next to its field.

conflict.title: Someone saved version {{version}} while you were editing
conflict.body: Your changes are based on version {{base}}. Nothing was saved. Keep your draft to review it against version {{version}}, or discard it.
conflict.theirs: Rules changed in the saved version
conflict.theirsRegistry: Secrets changed in the saved version

errors.conflictUnreadable: Someone else saved the policy, and the latest version couldn't be read. Reload before saving.
errors.unknownBody: The controller didn't answer, and the policy it now returns doesn't match your draft. Your draft is kept; check and save again.

audit.title: Every decision, in view.
audit.description: Metadata for requests, decisions and administration. The log never holds secret values, keys or links.
audit.searchHint: Matches event, actor or resource among the rows loaded.
audit.lookupHint: Open the full timeline of one exchange.
audit.noMatchBody: Filters only apply to the page loaded. Try older pages or clear the filter.

timeline.title: Exchange timeline
timeline.description: Every recorded step of this exchange, oldest first.
timeline.notFoundBody: The controller has no events for this ID. Check it was copied in full.
timeline.boundary: Times come from the controller. Events show what the controller recorded, not what a recipient did with a secret.

approvals.title: Approve with context.
approvals.description: Check who is asking and for what before each decision. The controller re-checks your permission when you decide.

empty.pendingBody: New requests appear here within a few seconds.
empty.otherBody: No approvals on this page have this status.

select.title: Select an approval
select.body: Choose a request from the queue to see what the controller verified.

detail.notFoundBody: The controller doesn't return this reference. It may be mistyped, or an exchange approval whose decision window has closed; the audit log keeps its history.

verified.title: Verified by the controller
verified.exchangeNote: The requester is the agent whose credential made this request. The purpose below is that agent's own text.
verified.operationNote: Node, workload, unit and account come from the approved enrollment and registration, not from the request text.

members.title: Operations in this group
members.body: Approving decides all of them together. Each one keeps its own requester and broker evidence.
members.unavailable: The member list is shown on the detail read only.

boundary.exchange: Approving authorizes this exchange. It doesn't limit what the recipient does with the secret once delivered.
boundary.operation: Approving authorizes these operations for the verified workload only. The grant goes to that node's broker.

confirm.rejectBody: The requester is told the request was rejected. A decision can't be undone.
confirm.approveBody: The controller checks the latest state before recording your decision. A decision can't be undone.

outcome.approvedExchange: Your decision is recorded. Nothing has been delivered yet: the requester still has to complete the exchange.
outcome.approvedOperation: Your decision is recorded and the controller issued the grant. Follow the operation to see whether the broker received and used it.

blocked.not_pending: This approval is closed. No decision is available.
blocked.not_named: You aren't a named approver for this rule. The controller would refuse your decision.
blocked.self: You requested one of these operations. Another named approver must decide.
blocked.viewer: Your role can read approvals but not decide them.

errors.staleBody: It was decided, expired or changed after you opened it. The latest state is shown below. Your decision was not recorded.
errors.changedBeforeSend: It changed while you were confirming, so nothing was sent. Review the latest details before deciding.
errors.scopeTitle: You aren't an approver for this request
errors.scopeBody: The policy names other operators for it. Ask one of them to decide.
errors.selfTitle: You can't decide your own request
errors.selfBody: Another named approver must decide this group.
errors.grantTitle: Approved, but no grant was issued
errors.grantBody: The controller recorded the approval, but current policy or workload state prevents issuing the grant. Check the policy and workload before the requester tries again.
errors.unknownBody: The controller may or may not have recorded it. Check the current status before doing anything else.
errors.stillPendingBody: The controller shows no decision yet. Sending again reuses the same request key, so the decision can't be recorded twice.
errors.goneTitle: This approval is no longer available
errors.goneBody: The controller no longer returns it: its decision window closed or it was removed. Your decision was not recorded. The audit log keeps its history.
errors.failedBody: The controller refused it ({{code}}). Nothing changed.

stats.nodesHint: Status comes from each node's last contact with the controller.
stats.agentsHint: Active means enrolled and not revoked, not that the agent is online.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.emptyBody: Decisions and administration appear here as they happen.

overview.description: Pending decisions first, then fleet state and recent activity.

common.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the text instead

forbidden.title: Your role can't open this
forbidden.body: The controller refused this request for your role. Ask an administrator if you need access.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: The controller has no record with this identifier. It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.body: The controller is rate limiting this session. Wait a moment, then try again.
rateLimited.bodyAfter: The controller is rate limiting this session. Try again in {{seconds}} s.

timeout.title: The controller didn't answer in time
timeout.body: Nothing is shown in place of the missing data. Try again; if it keeps timing out, check the controller host.

network.title: Can't reach the controller
network.body: The request didn't get a response. This is not an empty result.

unavailable.title: The controller is not ready
unavailable.body: Its store is unavailable or still starting. Try again shortly.

clockFenced.title: The controller clock is fenced
clockFenced.body: The controller detected a clock regression and stopped accepting sessions. An administrator must run blindpass admin reconcile-clock on the host.

passwordChange.title: Change your temporary password first
passwordChange.body: Administration stays locked until the temporary password is replaced.

server.title: The controller returned an error
server.body: Request failed with status {{status}}. Nothing was assumed from it.

time.estimateNote: Estimated from the controller clock. The controller's own expiry check is final.

roles.adminHint: Manages agents, policy, fleet registration and operators
roles.operatorHint: Decides approvals and revokes grants within policy
roles.viewerHint: Reads fleet state, policy and audit history

session.extendFailed: Couldn't extend the session. Save your work and sign in again.

unreachable.body: The console is served by the controller but can't reach its API. Check that the controller is running and its store is ready.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: Check the address, or go back to the overview.

forbidden.title: Your role can't open this page
forbidden.body: You're signed in as {{role}}. The controller enforces the same limit on its API.

removed.title: Not available in this product
removed.body: Billing, usage analytics, public offers, self-service sign-up and email password reset belonged to the hosted service. The local BlindPass controller doesn't provide them.

logoutFailed.title: Sign-out didn't complete
logoutFailed.body: The controller didn't confirm the session ended. Try again before leaving this device.

auth.passwordRule: At least 12 characters. A passphrase of several words works well.

origin.title: This address isn't allowed
origin.body: The controller rejected the request's origin or CSRF check. Open the console from the controller's configured address.

setup.lead: Create the first administrator. Setup works once, with a short-lived token minted on the controller host.

token.title: Mint a setup token
token.body: On the controller host, as its service user, run

account.title: Choose the administrator account
account.body: The token works once and expires after 15 minutes.

done.title: Start in the console
done.body: You're signed in straight away. Setup then closes for good.

setup.formBody: The setup token is sent once and never shown again.

fields.tokenHint: Paste the value printed by blindpass admin bootstrap-token.

errors.token: Paste the full setup token (at least 32 characters).
errors.rejected: The controller rejected these fields. Check the username and password rules.
errors.failed: Setup didn't complete. No administrator was created; you can try again with the same token if it hasn't expired.

raced.title: Setup is already complete
raced.body: Another administrator finished setup first. Your account was not created. Sign in with an existing administrator account.

tokenSpent.title: This setup token can't be used
tokenSpent.body: It is expired or already used. Mint a new one on the controller host and paste it here.

login.lead: Review who is asking, decide with the verified context, and keep an audit trail of what happened.

verified.title: Verified context first
verified.body: The controller's own identity evidence is shown apart from anything a requester wrote.

decide.title: Decide the exact scope
decide.body: Approvals name the recipient, action and lifetime before you confirm.

audit.title: Every decision is recorded
audit.body: Audit history holds metadata only, never secret values.

login.formBody: Use the local account an administrator created for you.
login.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
login.signedOut: You signed out. The controller ended the session.

errors.credentials: The username or password is incorrect.
errors.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.

recovery.title: Can't sign in?
recovery.admin: Ask an administrator to reset your password from Operators. You'll get a temporary password and must change it at sign-in.
recovery.host: If no administrator can sign in, reset one on the controller host:
recovery.noEmail: There is no email reset: the controller has no mail service.

password.title: Change password
password.body: Choose a new password for this account.

forced.body: {{name}} signed in with a temporary password. Choose a new one to unlock the console.

errors.same: Choose a password different from the current one.
errors.session: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.failed: The password wasn't changed. Try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your profile, password, language and session on this controller.

profile.title: Profile
profile.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change names and roles.

language.title: Language
language.body: Applies to this browser, including secret-input pages opened here.

session.title: Session
session.expiresHint: Stay signed in extends it; inactivity can end it sooner.

enrollment.title: Bring a machine in.
enrollment.description: Issue a one-use token, let the node submit its keys, then approve only the exact keys you verified on the machine.
enrollment.emptyBody: Create an enrollment to get a one-use token for a new node.
enrollment.boundary: A node name is a label chosen by an administrator. The node's identity is its key fingerprint, and only the fingerprint check ties it to the machine.

fields.name: Node name
fields.nameHint: Up to 128 characters. Shown to operators; it doesn't identify the machine.

create.title: Create an enrollment
create.body: The controller issues a one-use token for this node.

reveal.title: Enrollment token for {{name}}
reveal.body: Paste it into the command below on the node. It works once and can't be shown again.
reveal.label: One-use enrollment token
reveal.command: On the node, run this and paste the token when asked:
reveal.issuer: The issuer fingerprint pins this controller; the node refuses any other.
reveal.issuerUnavailable: The issuer fingerprint can't be computed here (the controller has no fleet issuer, or this page isn't on HTTPS or localhost). Get it on the controller host.

review.title: Review {{name}}
review.instructionTitle: Approve only when the fingerprint matches exactly.
review.instruction: Copy the fingerprint that blindpass-node printed on the machine itself. The console never shows the submitted value first, so a match proves you saw the same keys.
review.fingerprintHint: 64 hex characters. Spaces and colons are ignored.
review.mismatch: This doesn't match the keys the controller received. Don't approve: the token may have been used by another machine. Reject and issue a new one.

errors.name: Enter a name of up to 128 characters without control characters.
errors.createUnknown: The controller didn't answer. An enrollment may exist without its token; let it expire and create another.
errors.changed: The enrollment changed, the fingerprint differs, or an active node already has this name. Reload and review again.
errors.keyReused: These keys belong to a node enrolled before. Reject this enrollment.
errors.expired: The enrollment expired. Create a new one.
errors.decideUnknown: The controller didn't answer. Reload to see whether the decision was recorded.

node.title: Nodes you trust.
node.description: Approved machines, their keys and when the controller last heard from them.
node.emptyBody: Approved enrollments appear here as nodes.
node.boundary: Status is computed by the controller from the node's last contact. Online means recently connected, not that a workload is healthy.
node.revocationPendingBody: The controller no longer trusts this node. The node applies the signed revocation and closes its session when it next connects; until then it may still hold grants it received.
node.revokedBody: The node applied its revocation. Its keys can't be enrolled again.
node.rotationPendingBody: Key version {{version}} is staged. The old key stays active until the broker applies the signed rotation.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.body: The controller stops trusting this node and queues a signed revocation for its broker. Grants already delivered can't be recalled until the node reconnects. This can't be undone.
revoke.unknown: The controller didn't answer. Reload to see whether the node was revoked.

rotate.title: Rotate keys for {{name}}
rotate.body: Run the command on the node, then paste the three values it prints. The old key stays active until the broker applies the rotation.
rotate.fingerprintHint: The controller checks it against the two keys.
rotate.invalid: The keys or fingerprint don't match. Copy them again from the node.
rotate.changed: The node's keys changed since this page loaded. Reload first.
rotate.unknown: The controller didn't answer. Reload to see whether the rotation was staged.

workload.title: What runs where.
workload.description: A workload binds a service unit and account on one node. Only the registration decides who may receive a grant.
workload.emptyBody: Register a workload on an approved node.
workload.boundary: The node's broker checks the unit and account of each process before delivering a grant; the workload name is only a label.
workload.identityNote: Identity evidence is the unit and account the broker verifies on the node, not the name.

fields.nodeHint: Only approved, unrevoked nodes are listed.
fields.name: Workload name
fields.accountHint: Lowercase account name, or uid:N for a non-root UID.
fields.ceilingHint: Longest the workload may keep a delivered value, 1–3600 seconds.

create.title: Register a workload
create.body: Grants go only to processes that match this unit and account on the chosen node.

edit.title: Edit registration
edit.identityTitle: This changes who can receive grants
edit.identityBody: Changing the unit, account or delivery withdraws this workload's outstanding grants, approvals and requests.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.body: Issued or delivered grants get signed revocations, pending approvals expire and pending requests are cancelled. A value the workload already received isn't recalled. This can't be undone.

errors.name: Enter a name of up to 128 characters.
errors.unit: Enter the unit, up to 256 characters.
errors.account: Use a lowercase account name (up to 32 of a–z 0–9 _ . -) or uid:N.
errors.ceiling: Use a whole number from 1 to 3600.
errors.unitConflict: An active workload on this node already uses this unit.
errors.modeDenied: The node doesn't support this delivery.
errors.nodeUnavailable: This node can't take workloads (revoked or not approved).
errors.changed: The registration changed since you opened it. The latest is loaded; review and save again.
errors.unknown: The controller didn't answer. Reload to see what was saved.

policy.title: Decide what nodes may do.
policy.description: One rule per action and delivery. Operations that match no rule are refused.
policy.neverEdited: Default policy — no operator has edited it yet.
policy.readOnly: Only administrators can change the fleet policy.
policy.noneBody: Requests for this delivery are refused.

fields.approversHint: Operator usernames or IDs, one per line (1–32). A requester can't approve their own operation.

policy.boundary: Saving a new version withdraws pending approvals that relied on the old rules.
policy.conflictTitle: Someone saved the fleet policy while you were editing
policy.conflictBody: Nothing was saved. Version {{version}} is now current; load it and make your change again.

errors.ttl: Use a whole number from 1 to 3600.
errors.approvers: Name 1–32 approvers using letters, digits and _ . @ -.
errors.invalid: The controller refused a rule. Check each decision, lifetime and approver list.
errors.unknown: The controller didn't answer. Reload to see whether the policy changed.

grant.title: Grants in flight.
grant.description: Each grant authorizes one operation for one verified workload. Metadata only; grants never carry secret values here.
grant.boundary: Revoking stops future use. It can't undo a delivery the workload already consumed; that workload may hold the value up to its local ceiling.

revoke.label: Revoke grant for {{unit}}
revoke.title: Revoke this grant?
revoke.body: The controller signs a revocation for the node's broker. The result below says whether anything may already have been used.

grant_revoked.title: Grant revoked
grant_revoked.body: The node is connected and receives the signed revocation. The grant wasn't used.

not_revocable_offline.title: Revoked, but the node is offline
not_revocable_offline.body: The controller won't honour this grant again, but the node can't be told until it reconnects. If its broker already holds the grant, the workload may use it before it expires.

grant_revoked_after_consumption.title: Revoked after it was used
grant_revoked_after_consumption.body: The workload already consumed this grant. It may keep the delivered value for up to {{seconds}} seconds (its local ceiling). Rotate the underlying credential if that's not acceptable.

errors.notRevocable: This grant is no longer revocable (expired or already closed).
errors.unknown: The controller didn't answer. Reload to see the grant's status.

operation.title: Operations, end to end.
operation.description: Each operation shows its policy decision, approval, grant and the result the broker reported.
operation.emptyBody: Operations appear when a workload's request reaches the controller.
operation.resultNote: As reported by the node's broker. The controller records it; it doesn't verify the workload's own outcome.
operation.uncertainBody: The broker couldn't confirm whether the operation ran. Check the workload on the node before retrying.

cancel.title: Cancel this operation?
cancel.body: It is removed from its approval group and won't run.
cancel.revokeBody: The grant is revoked; the result says whether the workload already used it.

errors.notCancellable: This operation can no longer be cancelled.
errors.unknown: The controller didn't answer. Reload to see the operation's status.
